name: Avenue Supermarts Ltd.
about: Avenue Supermarts Limited engages in the business of organized retail and operation of supermarkets under the D-Mart brand name in India. The company offers food products, such as groceries, staples, processed food products, dairy, frozen products, beverages and confectionery products, and fruits and vegetables; non-food products, including home care and personal care products, toiletries, and other over the counter products; and general merchandise and apparel products comprising bed and bath products, toys and games, crockery, plastic goods, garments, footwear, utensils, and home appliances. It is also involved in the online and multi-channel retail of grocery and household products under the DMart Ready brand name; packing and sale of grocery products, spices, dry fruits, etc.; operation of food outlets and pharmacy stores; and development of land and construction. verdict.label: Looks expensive
reasons: Price implies ~34% a year profit growth for 10 years, versus ~17% that history and analysts support (reverse DCF at 10.8% cost of equity).
PE of 74 is near the bottom of its range over the last 3 years (median 102), though that is a short history to judge by.
Trades at PE 74 vs sector median 56; peers with similar ROCE and growth trade nearer 42, so the premium is not explained by fundamentals alone.
